shortDescription: MCP and A2A gateway and registry that federates tools, agents and REST APIs behind one endpoint, with an admin UI, PostgreSQL and Redis.

alerts.message: Sign in at /admin with PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAIL (admin@example.com) and the generated PLATFORM_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment. The account is created on first start; changing these variables later does not update it, so change the password from the admin UI.
